lts_stigma.definition: A mark of disgrace that a group attaches to a status, so that the status itself becomes hard to show.
lts_stigma.example: In some offices there is a stigma against a long single life, and in others there is none.

pd_persuasion.definition: An honest attempt to win agreement, in which the other person is free to say no.
pd_persuasion.example: That was persuasion, not pressure: he explained the plan and left the decision to her.
